name: Wanted: Vile Priestess Hexx and Her Minions
label: Quest
description: Primal Torntusk has ordered Vile Priestess Hexx and her minions brought to justice, and a grand prize awaits anyone who slays the priestess and her elite…
intro: Primal Torntusk has ordered Vile Priestess Hexx and her minions brought to justice, and a grand prize awaits anyone who slays the priestess and her elite Aman'zasi guard. You will find them atop Jintha'alor in the Hinterlands.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: By order of Primal Torntusk, Vile Priestess Hexx and her minions are to be brought to justice!
A grand reward is offered for any that slay the Vile Priestess Hexx and all of her Aman'zasi elite guard.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you bring news from Jintha'alor?

clips.title: Completion
paras: A crippling blow to the Vilebranch, indeed. You shall be richly rewarded, friend.
